subject: Control concordance & evidence acceleration for SIG/ISO/SOC2 packet
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@clearwater.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@clearwater.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG/ISO/SOC2 crosswalk & evidence cadence

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — product looked good. We need to move fast on the SIG questionnaire and the SOC 2/ISO crosswalk for our procurement committee. Two asks up front: 1) can you provide a single control-concordance file that maps SIG controls to your SOC 2/ISO controls, and 2) can you share an evidence manifest we can hand to our internal auditors (owner, artifact, retention, timestamp)?

We'd like a proposed delivery plan this week and a short call with your security lead to validate a couple of technical artifacts (arch diagram, KMS notes). Can you also flag anything that will need legal review (e.g., subprocessor lists or contractual exceptions)?

Thanks — if we can get a clear mapping and a compact evidence set by EOD Thursday it will keep our procurement sprint on track.

Cheers,
Liam
Procurement Manager
Clearwater Systems

From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@clearwater.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@clearwater.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG/ISO/SOC2 crosswalk & evidence cadence

Hi Liam — great to hear the demo landed well. We can absolutely accelerate that. High level plan (short):

- Deliverables by Thu 2026-10-08 EOD: consolidated SIG->SOC2/ISO crosswalk (single workbook), evidence manifest (PDF) with artifacts and owners, and an architecture diagram with KMS callouts.
- Quick sync: 30 min technical readout with our security lead (Neha) — propose Tue 2026-10-06 10:00 PT.
- Legal flags: default subprocessor list included; anything deviating from our standard DPA will be flagged for legal review.

I'll attach the first-pass crosswalk and the manifest (work-in-progress) to this thread, and Ben will coordinate the artifact pulls. If that timeline works I'll lock the call.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai

Attachments: RW_SIG_Crosswalk_v1.xlsx (WIP), SOC2-ISO_evidence_manifest.pdf (draft)

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@clearwater.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@clearwater.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: SIG/ISO/SOC2 crosswalk & evidence cadence

Thanks — looping in to confirm what I'll need from infra and product to close the manifest. Quick ask list:

1) Current SOC 2 Type II report date and link to the report PDF (for the manifest reference).
2) Golden architecture diagram (png) that highlights network boundaries, VPC peering, and KMS/HSM mention — I'll add short captions for auditors.
3) Owner contacts for the following artifact buckets: identity (SSO/SCIM logs), secrets management (KMS usage reports), change control (PR history and release notes), and incident response (post-incident reports for the last 12 months).

Neha — can you confirm who owns the KMS usage report and whether we have a redacted export suitable for external sharing? If not, what is the earliest ETA?

I'll prepare the consolidated crosswalk (finalize control numbering and short control rationales) once I have the above.

-Ben
Principal Security Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@clearwater.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@clearwater.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: RE: SIG/ISO/SOC2 crosswalk & evidence cadence

Hi all —

KMS usage: we can produce a redacted usage report showing CMK creation/events and key usage counts for the requested 12-month window. ETA: I can generate the export and have it reviewed for redaction by EOD Wed 2026-10-07.

SOC 2 report: current Type II covers period 2025-11-01 to 2026-10-31 — I will provide a secure link to the certified PDF (internal control owner signoff required) by Wed.

Owners: identity logs (Ethan Park), change control (Jordan Blake), incident reports (Mina Haddad). I'll include short contact lines for each in the manifest.

Note on legal flags: we use a limited subprocessor list; any requested deviation (e.g., adding a Clearwater-specific subproc) will route to contracts.

-Neha
Head of Security & Compliance (acting) | Redwood Inference

From: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@clearwater.com>

Subject: Re: SIG/ISO/SOC2 crosswalk & evidence cadence

Stephanie / team — really appreciate the quick turnaround plan. Tue 10/06 10:00 PT works for the sync; we added Liam and our internal auditor (Ellen Park) to the invite. Two quick clarifications before the call:

- Is the crosswalk going to include short rationales (1-2 sentences) for each mapped pairing? That will help our audit acceptance criteria.
- For evidence delivery: can you provide the manifest as a signed PDF (with a short attestation line) and a separate folder with redacted artifacts? Our auditors prefer signed manifest + artifact package.

If you can confirm those two items we'll lock the review time.

Thanks,
Priya Sharma
Senior Security Auditor | Clearwater Systems
